_meta.note: Reusable discussion templates; no researched offer or success-rate claims. The user contacts the provider and verifies every offered price.

call_script: Use the support number on your bill or the provider's official website. Ask who can review plan pricing.
State your actual current monthly charge and the amount you would like to budget. Explain a promotion ending or bill change only if that happened.
Ask: "Are there any plans, promotions or account-specific discounts available that would lower my total bill?"
If you have a real, available competitor offer for comparable service, describe its total price and ask whether the provider can match it.
Ask whether removing unused services, changing equipment or enrolling in eligible payment options would reduce the total cost.
Before agreeing, ask about taxes, fees, equipment, installation, cancellation charges, service changes, contract length and the price after any promotion.
Ask for the effective date, guaranteed rate duration and written confirmation. Do not authorize changes you do not understand.
chat_script: Open the provider's official support site or app.
State your actual current bill and ask for available options to lower the total cost.
Compare any offered plan against your required service and a real alternative offer, if you have one.
Ask for all fees, contract conditions, promotion end date and the post-promotion price in writing.
Save the transcript and confirmation before reporting the result.
talking_points: Mention customer tenure and payment history only if accurate.
Ask whether existing-customer promotions or discounts apply to your account. Availability is not guaranteed.
Compare equivalent service including taxes, recurring fees, equipment and commitment.
If the first agent cannot review pricing, politely ask whether another team can help. A second conversation does not guarantee a better offer.
